Chlorination Production Unit Test
DENORA, Italy
رقم الوثيقة: CPUT-001-r0

صدرت إلى: 
 Ataka PS
حالة: موافقة
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The chlorination producing unit function is to produce 
hypo-chloride Sodium by electrical analysis to sea water.

The Chlorination Production Unit consists of: 
five Electrolysers, two sea water pumps, two Filters, two degasifiers, two fans, 
two continuous dosing pumps, two shock dosing pumps, two storage tanks, two Flow 
control loops, one level control loop.

For testing the Chlorination Producing Unit 
perform the following:

اختبار الإطلاق والحماية للمحلل الكهربائي، 
مضخات مياه البحر، والمرشحات، وأجهزة إزالة الغاز، والمراوح، ومضخات الجرعات المستمرة، والصدمات 
مضخات الجرعات.

Check the Flow/ Level control loops components 
(Level/Flow transmitters, mA/pn. converters, pneumatic actuators (positioners), 
controllers , limit value cards and solenoid valves.
